t: The Command-Line Crucible: Forging Precision AI with Unix Philosophy
s: This article advocates for a shift from chat-based AI interaction to a command-line interface, leveraging the Unix philosophy for deterministic and precise agentic AI workflows. It emphasizes treating AI's inherent amnesia as a feature and formalizes a 'SNEFU to ROFSA' playbook for resilient agent development.
sub: Command-line AI interaction vs. chat paradigm
Unix pipe philosophy for AI prompting
AI amnesia as a feature for deterministic workflows
SNEFU to ROFSA playbook for agentic resilience
Tool-calling fragility and deterministic alternatives (e.g., sed)
